claims.claim: A used dry pressing iron that is still working
claims.evidence: No photo shows the iron powered on, heating, or any test of function; soleplate and controls not visible.

claims.claim: Dry pressing iron (implying no steam/water function)
claims.evidence: Soleplate and water tank area are not shown, so presence or absence of steam function cannot be confirmed from the photo.

risks.risk: Exposed/frayed wire strands near the plug could be a shock or fire hazard, and may mean the iron cannot be safely used as-is
risks.proof: Close-up photo or clip of the cord end and plug showing the exact state of the insulation and wire strands
risks.if_unproven: priced as unsafe/needs rewiring, i.e. non-functional until repaired

risks.risk: Soleplate condition (scratches, rust, residue, smoothness) unknown and could affect pressing quality
risks.proof: Clear photo of the soleplate from underneath

risks.risk: Actual heating/power function unverified despite seller's claim
risks.proof: Short video clip of the iron plugged in, powering on, and heating up (e.g. water droplet sizzle test or visible heat indicator)

risks.risk: No brand/model visible, so market value tier and spare parts availability are unknown
risks.proof: Photo of the underside or back of the iron showing any brand/model marking

risks.risk: Temperature dial or control knob functionality unverified
risks.proof: Clip showing the dial being turned through its range
risks.if_unproven: priced as if control may be faulty

risks.risk: Full cord length and condition beyond the shown section unknown
risks.proof: Photo of the entire cord laid out
risks.if_unproven: priced as if cord needs replacement

proof_requests: Close-up photo/clip of the plug end showing the exposed wire clearly
Photo of the soleplate from underneath
Video of the iron plugged in and heating up
Photo of underside/back for brand or model marking
Photo of the full cord length
Clip of the temperature dial being turned
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a generic electric dry iron with visible dirt, a frayed cord, and exposed wiring at the plug, so it can be priced at worst case (unsafe cord, unverified function, unknown soleplate) pending the listed proofs that could raise the price.
